draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Possesses uncommon competitive streak and attitude.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.27, the 73rd-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 14th of 34 at WR. He went 57th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Adam Humphries. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 657 receiving yards in 2019, 27th of 34 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders (practice squad). 94 career games and 54 starts over 6 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2021. Strengths in 2025: drop rate 0.0% (98th percentile). Weak spots: yards after catch per reception 2.9 (14th percentile), catch rate 55.8% (20th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 wide receiver who played: 350 receiving yards against a median of 502, below the norm.
